Get to know me

About me

I'm Yada, a Statistics and Data Science student at King Mongkut's University of Technology Thonburi. I focus on problems where rigorous statistics informs real business decisions, such as how prices shape demand and which promotions are effective.

As a Data Science Intern at Central Food Retail (Tops Market), I built end-to-end Python, SQL and BigQuery pipelines for price elasticity, cannibalization, demand forecasting and promotion spillover. The team now uses my outputs in its price-optimization and promotion-planning work.

I also bring experience working in international, multidisciplinary teams: I've joined programs in Japan and Indonesia and hosted bilingual Thai–English events.
